item.title: In the Weeds with the Missouri Department of Conservation
item.description: Join Grace as she chats with Sara Karnes from the MDC about all the exciting events happening this month. From virtual programs like fish cleaning and morel mushroom hunting to guided hikes on the Wildcat Trail and Wildflower Nature Hike, there’s something for everyone. Bring the kids for free spring break hatchery tours, try wildflower bingo, or learn falconry with expert Megan Duffy Yates.

item.description: Discover how the Breast Cancer Foundation of the Ozarks supports local families, from paying bills during treatment to free mammograms, and don’t miss their emotional ‘A Time to Share’ Fashion Show on April 23, 2026. Learn how you can help at bcfo.org.

item.title: Milk, Eggs, &amp; 5 Generations of Grit: The Justin Raef Story
item.description: On Beyond the Gate, Jamie talks with Justin Raef, a fifth-generation Missouri dairyman and poultry producer, about the grit, family teamwork, and daily grind of running a Century Farm in 2026.
